description: A Comprehensive LiDAR Point Cloud Dataset of Telecommunication Towers (TowerScope) is a data set described in the paper "A Comprehensive LiDAR Point Cloud Dataset of Telecommunication Towers (TowerScope)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2024), produced by Amzar Omairi, Zool Hilmi Ismail, Mohd Ibrahim Shapiai. This article describes a dataset of light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds captured using the DJI Matrice 300 equipped with the DJI Zenmuse L1 sensor. The TowerScope point cloud dataset contains 29 LiDAR scans from telecommunication towers in Log ASCII Standard (LAS) and wavefront OBJect (OBJ) formats, capturing the main tower or mast structure, antennas, transmission equipment, and supporting infrastructure installed on telecommunication towers from various sites. Coverage: 29 telecommunication towers scanned by drone. The data are held on Harvard Dataverse, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC0-1.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication tower digital twins and structural condition assessment. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
